title: Repair failed integration with one reserved worker checkout

rubric.text: Resumes W1 in its clean idle checkout with the slot still reserved, using a fresh unique branch from the failed integrated SHA. Accounts for needed artifacts and preserves the original task branch, accepted commit, failed integrated commit and check evidence.

Keeps B and further integration on hold during repair. Inspects the task-scoped repair, verifies the integration checkout is clean at the failed SHA before integrating it, and reruns affected checks on the repaired integrated SHA before releasing B or the slot.
Pauses when a process is still using the only checkout, keeps W1 and the reservation, and checks whether the checkout is clean and idle before resuming.
